name: oot_enemy_bari
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's electric jellyfish in Majora's Mask: the Bari drops from above and splits into three Biri when beaten, and the small Biri drift after you. Both shock a sword that touches them. Custom enemies oot.bari and oot.biri and their shared soul soul.oot.bari. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
